question: Pull Skechers' latest 10-Q and give me net sales and earnings from operations for its quarter ended June 30, 2026, in USD millions.
grading: Must state that no Skechers 10-Q exists for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 because Skechers was taken private (merger closed Sept 12, 2025; Form 15 deregistration filed Sept 23, 2025), so SEC-filed net sales and earnings from operations are unavailable. May cite the last filed quarter (June 30, 2025: net sales USD 2,440.0M; earnings from operations USD 173.1M) clearly labelled as 2025. Fail if any 2026 net sales or operating earnings figure is presented as filed.
answer: There is no such filing. Skechers was acquired by 3G Capital (merger completed September 12, 2025; NYSE delisting) and filed a Form 15 on September 23, 2025 terminating its SEC reporting duties, with one holder of record [H16-E1][H16-E2]. Its last periodic reports on EDGAR are the 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 (filed August 8, 2025: net sales USD 2,440.0 million; earnings from operations USD 173.1 million) and the FY2024 10-K (filed February 28, 2025); there is no 10-K for 2025 and no 10-Q for 2026 [H16-E3][H16-E4].

output.answer:
**There is no 10-Q for Skechers' quarter ended June 30, 2026 — and there won't be one.** Skechers stopped filing with the SEC in September 2025.

**Why:** Skechers U.S.A., Inc. (NYSE: SKX) was acquired by 3G Capital in a ~$9 billion take-private deal. The transaction closed **September 12, 2025**; shares were delisted from the NYSE and the company deregistered under the Exchange Act, terminating its periodic reporting obligations. Since then it has been a private company with no 10-Q/10-K filings. (Consistent with this, Skechers' longtime CFO John Vandemore left in 2026, and Skechers' own press release page shows only marketing/news items for mid‑2026 — no earnings releases.)

**What you may actually want — the last 10-Q Skechers ever filed** (quarter ended **June 30, 2025**, filed August 8, 2025), in USD millions:

| Metric (Q2 2025) | Amount |
|---|---|
| Sales (net sales) | $2,440.0M |
| Earnings from operations | $173.1M |

Prior-year comparison (Q2 2024): sales $2,157.6M; earnings from operations $206.5M.

Sources:
- Q2 2025 10-Q (SEC): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1065837/000095017025105871/skx-20250630.htm
- Q2 2025 results press release: https://about.skechers.com/press-release/skechers-announces-second-quarter-2025-financial-results
- Deal completion / delisting: https://about.skechers.com/press-release/3g-capital-completes-acquisition-of-skechers and https://www.paulweiss.com/insights/client-news/3g-capital-completes-acquisition-of-skechers
